name: frames-benchmark-chunksize-1024-chunkoverlap-20
description: This frames benchmark variant evaluates document/knowledge‑frame retrieval and QA behavior when long inputs are chunked with a 1024 token chunk size and 20 token overlap. It measures how well retrieval and downstream QA perform given this specific chunking strategy, highlighting effects of chunk size and overlap on retrieval accuracy and answer extraction. Typical use is to compare indexing/retrieval pipelines and QA models under consistent chunking parameters.
reputation: A niche, implementation‑focused benchmark used by practitioners experimenting with chunking strategies and retrieval pipelines; limited broad community adoption.
